description: Exact reusable integral families join harmonic/binomial recurrences to cyclotomic phase filters and an explicit E8 Coxeter model.

highlights.detail: Every selected-order pair through weight 33, with exact harmonic/zeta coefficients and rational tails; no independence claim.
highlights.label: Raghava construction

highlights.detail: The complete 264-branch fiber becomes one; its 240 primitive field conjugates become two with exact inclusion-exclusion.
highlights.label: Phase reduction

highlights.detail: The explicit 248-dimensional cyclic root-permutation-plus-Cartan model has a unique real Mellin zero for s>1 at s=2.
highlights.label: E8 integral cancellation

highlights.detail: The real weight-two sum over the 240 primitive phases, checked against complete-source Bernoulli evaluation.
highlights.label: Exact example

highlights.detail: Raghava arcsine moment at t=2sin(pi/840); the refined angle divides this value by 264^2.
highlights.label: Artifact-angle bridge

highlights.detail: Integer reflection construction, Coxeter order 30 and characteristic polynomial Phi30 are checked.
highlights.label: Actual E8 geometry

highlights.detail: Decimal arithmetic at precision 200 with independently Euler-transformed zeta values; these numerical comparisons are not rigorous enclosures.
highlights.label: Independent diagnostics

limits: This does not prove the supplied artifacts categorical colimit or arbitrary E8 unification claims.
The 240 Galois conjugates are not identified with the 240 E8 roots by matching cardinalities.
The E8 root-permutation-plus-Cartan model is a verified cyclic direct sum; no adjoint lift with root-space signs is asserted.
The two-order family is complete only within the cited polynomial ansatz; identities need not be numerically linearly independent.
Numerical Decimal comparisons are diagnostics and have no rigorous zeta enclosure.
title: Integral families: Raghava, phase geometry and E8
